english.title: Fail to give to an authorised person information / assistance / provide facilities that person may require

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Animal by products Enforcement Wales Regulations 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable cause to

(A)_[give information,]_
(B)_[give assistance,]_
(C)_[provide facilities that were reasonably required,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..), to **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a person authorised under regulation 22 of the Animal By-Products (Enforcement) (Wales) Regulations 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18(b) and 20 of the Animal By-Products (Enforcement) (Wales) Regulations 2014.

english.notes: In relation to offences committed prior to 28th March 2014, see offence document H11172.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
